shared_elements: dense field of script-like signs covering the rock face
signs organised into aligned horizontal rows or registers
carved relief signs with internal subdivisions (small circles, bars, nested rectangles)
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by a long, dense inscription of blocky, internally subdivided sign-units set in aligned horizontal rows across a rock face, which is a fairly specific shared scheme rather than mere generic pattern. The clearest difference is that A includes a pictorial element (a figure/animal-like form) interrupting the top of the text field and its signs are much finer and more varied in outline, while B shows only large, coarse, uniformly rectangular sign-blocks with no figural content.
